test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, one got 55% of the total valid votes, and 20% of the votes were invalid. If the total number of votes was 7500, the number of valid votes that the other candidate got was:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Votes** = 7500

**Valid Votes** = 80% of 7500 = 6000

Winner gets 55%, so **Other Candidate** gets 45% of valid votes.

Other Candidate = 45% of 6000 = 0.45 × 6000 = 2700

**∴ The correct answer is 2700 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9076232998c42f74065206d73a3977e5182e2ccd28a37a9e471dddde464def6d.png] 

**Given:**

Total votes = 7500

Invalid votes = 20%

Winner candidate share = 55% of valid votes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Valid votes = 7500 × (100 − 20)%

⇒ Total Valid votes = 7500 × 80/100 = 6000

⇒ Other candidate share = 100% − 55% = 45% of valid votes

⇒ Votes for other candidate = 45/100 × 6000

⇒ Votes for other candidate = 45 × 60 = 2700

**∴ The correct answer is 2700 votes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

Always identify the correct base for percentages. In elections, candidate percentages are usually calculated on **Valid Votes**, not **Total Votes**, unless specified otherwise.

Successive Percentage Shortcut

Result = Total × (Valid % / 100) × (Candidate % / 100). Here, 7500 × 0.80 × 0.45 = 2700.</p
